notes: This descriptor is a declaration-only local extension hint, not an installed KINGDOM host contract.
AFTERGLOW carries caller-supplied digest references for orientation; it is not identity, memory, consent, authorship, currentness, replay, truth, permission, or uninterrupted-continuity proof.

Digest shape excludes raw identity or task prose from the wire shape but does not prove reference minimization or eliminate linkability; callers must not derive reusable refs directly from private identifiers.
DeepSeek stays proposed_unaccepted, Dark Continent stays not_checked or hold, KARMA stays receipt-only, and Artbitrage stays review_required or hold.

A generated Handoff fact is only a three-field reference object. A generated Correspondence artifact is only a two-field content digest. The package never performs POST /v1/handoff, constructs a Correspondence event, or performs any persistence action.
